title: Istio
subtitle: Four clusters, one mesh: shared trust, a gateway pod and a NodePort per cluster.

boxes.label: Shared Root CA
boxes.says: One root of trust for all four.
boxes.detail: Each istiod gets an intermediate CA signed by this root, so a certificate from any cluster verifies in every cluster.

boxes.label: LB or VIP
boxes.says: Optional: one stable address per cluster.
boxes.detail: Add it when node IPs change, nodes fail, or a firewall wants one address. MetalLB, HAProxy with VRRP, or a cloud load balancer.

boxes.label: istiod A
boxes.says: Control plane: one istiod per cluster.
boxes.detail: Issues certificates to local sidecars, pushes routes, and reads the other clusters' Services through a remote secret to find their endpoints.

boxes.label: Pods A
boxes.says: Data plane: sidecars speak mTLS to every peer.
boxes.detail: Envoy runs beside each app on the worker nodes, holds a short-lived certificate and encrypts each call, in this cluster or another.

boxes.label: Gateway pod A
boxes.says: Data plane: a cross-cluster gateway for peers.
boxes.detail: An Envoy pod on port 18443 with SNI passthrough: mTLS stays end to end. Its network label tells peers to route here.

boxes.label: NodePort A
boxes.says: Data plane: NodePort opens the gateway on every node.
boxes.detail: Peers dial any node IP on the NodePort and the gateway pod receives it. On a private network no load balancer is needed.

steps.title: Trust
steps.text: One root CA signs each cluster's istiod.

steps.title: Identity
steps.text: Every istiod gives its sidecars certificates.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Each istiod learns the other clusters' Services.

steps.title: Network
steps.text: Each cluster carries its own network label.

steps.title: Call
steps.text: A call to another cluster leaves by the gateway.

steps.title: Expose
steps.text: NodePort is enough; a load balancer only adds a stable address.

declarations: One root CA signs every cluster.
Each cluster runs its own istiod.
NodePort plus gateway is enough privately.
